cases.given: a readable named local image and no explicit output path
expect: timestamped Markdown on the first run

cases.given: the same source image is processed twice
expect: each Markdown references its own copy

cases.given: both target pairs would use the same millisecond run id
expect: check both Markdown and asset targets
reuse the final id across the pair

cases.given: a user specifies a directory or Markdown filename
expect: use a relative path from the Markdown file

cases.given: the source stem contains Chinese characters or spaces
expect: wrap the relative target in angle brackets
link resolves to the copied image

cases.given: source persistence or Markdown writing fails
expect: do not leave a Markdown file with a broken image link
